mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user ( username, password, avatar_url, phone, openid, generated_works_count, points, membership_status, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{username}, #{password}, #{avatarUrl}, #{phone}, #{openid}, #{generatedWorksCount}, #{points}, #{membershipStatus}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT user_id as userId, username, password, avatar_url as avatarUrl, phone, openid, generated_works_count as generatedWorksCount, points, membership_status as membershipStatus, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime FROM user WHERE username = #{username}

SELECT user_id as userId, username, password, avatar_url as avatarUrl, phone, openid, generated_works_count as generatedWorksCount, points, membership_status as membershipStatus, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime FROM user WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update:
